site.name: Unnati Index
site.description: Rankings and comparisons of Indian states across the economy, jobs, health, education, safety, governance, infrastructure, environment and inclusion, refreshed automatically from official sources.

home.status: Early preview. Data pipelines are being connected; rankings will appear here as official data loads.
home.pillarsIntro: The Unnati Index combines about 40 indicators into eight equally weighted pillars. Every indicator is a rate or per-person value, so large states don't win just by size.

principles.title: Fair comparisons
principles.body: States are ranked within peer groups (large states, North-East and Himalayan states, Union Territories) as well as overall.

principles.title: Progress, not just position
principles.body: Fixed goalposts mean a state's score rises only when its own numbers improve. Every leaderboard also shows who improved most.

principles.title: Honest about freshness
principles.body: Every number shows the period it covers, when we fetched it and when the next official release is expected.

principles.title: Accountable, not partisan
principles.body: Each figure is linked to the office-holders in charge during the period it describes, not just today's. Methodology, code and data are public.

economy-jobs.name: Economy & Jobs
economy-jobs.description: Prosperity, growth, employment and export competitiveness.

health.name: Health
health.description: Survival, nutrition and coverage of essential health services.

education.name: Education
education.description: Access, retention, learning and school readiness.

safety-justice.name: Safety & Justice
safety-justice.description: Personal safety, road safety and the capacity of police and courts.

governance-fiscal.name: Governance & Fiscal Health
governance-fiscal.description: Sustainable public finances and the quality of state spending.

infrastructure-digital.name: Infrastructure & Digital
infrastructure-digital.description: Water, sanitation, energy, clean cooking and connectivity for households.

environment.name: Environment
environment.description: Clean air, forests, clean energy, water security and waste management.

inclusion.name: Inclusion & Equality
inclusion.description: Poverty, gender equality and fair distribution of gains.

footer.disclaimer: Unnati Index is an independent, non-partisan project. Data comes from official publications, and each figure links to its source.

home.leadersIntro: Composite scores out of 100, by peer group. A higher score means the state is closer to national and global targets across eight pillars.
home.improvedIntro: Change in Unnati Index score, using the same methodology and fixed goalposts for both years.

rankings.title: Unnati Index rankings {year}
rankings.intro: Overall and pillar scores out of 100. Ranks are shown within each peer group, so small Union Territories are not compared directly with large states. Select a state for its full report card.

state.leadersIntro: Office-holders during {period}, the period of the latest data in this report card.
state.noLeaders: No office-holder records for this period yet.
state.notScored: Not enough data to compute an overall score yet.

indicators.title: Indicators
indicators.intro: Every indicator we track, grouped by topic. Indicators in a pillar feed the Unnati Index; the rest are shown for context.
indicators.coverage: {n} of {total} states and UTs have data

sources.title: Data sources
sources.intro: Every dataset, where it comes from and when we last checked it. The pipeline checks each source daily and loads only new or revised figures.
